program.name: All-Round Athlete
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: The full version of jump, lift, stick: longer jump sets, more lifting and a longer balance block.
program.about: The fullest athlete program here, about 40 minutes. Jumps, bounds and explosive push-ups come first on long rests, then a fuller strength block with dumbbells and a kettlebell, then a longer balance circuit. Lower, upper and full-body days rotate, and the lower and full days end with abs. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps, jumps bring more reps and harder variations, and balance drills add reps too. Come in fresh and rested.
program.split: Lower / upper / full body: the longest athlete sessions
program.gear: A pair of dumbbells or a kettlebell, and a sturdy chair or couch.
